# INTERIM REPORT OF GRAM-NEGATIVE COCCI

Gram-negative cocci may represent meningococci, gonococci, or moraxella. Based on the clinical situation, select from following possibilities:

# Refer to specific organism page when final culture results are available

[NEISSERIA MENINGITIDIS](gram-neg-n-meningitidis)

[NEISSERIA GONORRHOEAE](gram-neg-n-gonorrhoeae)

[MORAXELLA CATARRHALIS](gram-neg-m-catarrhalis)

References

- Warkowski et al, MMWR Recomm Rep 2015, 64.3
- Medical Letter Choice of Antimicrobials 2010, 8.94
- Mandell chapter: Neisseria Meningitidis
- Sanford keyword: Neisseria Meningitidis
- Sanford keyword: Neisseria Gonorrhoeae
Therapy:
## Empirical treatment if meningococci are suspected

Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h (Cost $$) R

## Empirical treatment if gonococci, moraxella are suspected or if unknown suspected organism

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h (Cost $) M

For suspected meningococci or gonococci and severe penicillin allergy Consult Infectious Diseases
For suspected moraxella and severe penicillin allergy
Azithromycin 500mg IV q24h (Cost $) O
